headline: Petco Appoints Jeffrey Naylor to Board of Directors
summary: Petco Health & Wellness Company, Inc. (Nasdaq: WOOF) today announced the appointment of Jeffrey Naylor, former Chief Financial Officer of TJX Companies, to its Board of Directors, effective August 1, 2026. In addition to his role on the Board, Mr. Naylor will serve as Chair of the company's Audit Committee.
